title: Ring introduces four new 4K cameras and a pan-tilt indoor cam
summary: Ring’s expanded camera lineup gives you more ways to see and protect your home, indoors and out.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Ring expands its Retinal 4K camera lineup with more flexible power options and its first indoor 4K camera built for the home.


- New pan-tilt camera features 360-degree coverage and 175-degree tilt, so you never miss a moment.


- The full lineup is available to purchase or preorder today in the U.S. and select countries worldwide.


---


From the front porch to the living room, Ring today introduced five new cameras built to cover every corner of the home. Leading the lineup, four new Retinal Vision 4K cameras bring sharp, true-color detail to any indoor or outdoor setup, with flexible power options ranging from plug-in, wired, battery, solar, and Power over Ethernet (PoE). Ring is also releasing the new Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam 2K, which follows motion with 360 degrees of coverage.


[Ring introduces TAKE, setting a new industry standard for default encryption and control](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/ring-take-encryption)


TAKE (Throw Away the Key Encryption) will become the default encryption for all Ring customers worldwide when fully rolled out.


## 4K for every corner of your home


Ring Outdoor Cam 4K


Last year,


[Ring set a new industry standard with Retinal Vision 4K](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/ring-camera-4k-home-security) . Today, Ring is expanding that lineup into its most flexible and complete 4K offering yet—four new cameras, each built with a wide-angle view, true-color low-light performance, and flexible power options. The new lineup includes:


- [Outdoor Cam 4K Plus](https://www.amazon.com/RingOutdoorCam4KPlusWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) : Ring’s next-generation outdoor camera featuring Retinal 4K, available in battery, plug-in, hardwired, solar, and PoE configurations.


- [Spotlight Cam 4K Plus](https://www.amazon.com/RingSpotlightCam4KPlusWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) :


Retinal 4K clarity with a built-in 550-lumen spotlight for added deterrence. Available in battery, plug-in, and solar configurations.


- [Floodlight Cam 4K Plus](https://www.amazon.com/RingFloodlightCam4KPlusWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) : Powerful floodlight deterrence paired with Retinal 4K detail. Supports 24/7 recording and smart detection.


- [Indoor Cam 4K](https://www.amazon.com/RingIndoorCam4KWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) : Brings Retinal 4K to Ring’s indoor lineup with a 115-degree field of view, dual-band Wi-Fi 6, and a physical privacy shutter.


Battery, solar, plug-in, hardwired, PoE, indoor, or outdoor—whatever a home needs, there’s a 4K camera that fits.


## Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam 2K: One camera, always in frame


Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam 2K


The all-new


[Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam 2K](https://www.amazon.com/RingPan-TiltIndoorCam2KWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) tackles an inherent challenge with fixed cameras: The things you care about don't always stay in frame. Your dog gets into something in the corner. Someone walks from one end of the house to the other. A delivery person drops a package on the far side of the porch. Once they move out of frame, you're left with half the story.


The Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam 2K fixes that—360 degrees of pan coverage and 175-degree tilt that intelligently follows motion, so you never miss what’s happening at home. It features 2K video quality, computer vision–based motion detection, and a physical privacy shutter that disables both the camera and microphone when closed.


Whether it’s seeing more clearly, reaching places cameras couldn't before, or keeping what matters in frame, Ring’s expanded camera lineup gives you more ways to see and protect your home.


[Ring launches NFL Game Day Cam Cover for all 32 teams](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/ring-nfl-game-day-cam-cover)


Ring's officially licensed NFL camera cover lets fans showcase team pride on their compatible indoor Ring cameras, just in time for the 2026-2027 NFL season.


## New Ring camera lineup availability


The


[Floodlight Camera 4K Plus](https://www.amazon.com/RingFloodlightCam4KPlusWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) and


[Spotlight Camera 4K Plus](https://www.amazon.com/RingSpotlightCam4KPlusWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) are available for preorder starting today in the U.S. They are also available for preorder in Canada, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Ireland, Belgium, and Sweden.


The


[Outdoor Camera 4K Plus](https://www.amazon.com/RingOutdoorCam4KPlusWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) is available for preorder starting today in the U.S. It is also available for preorder in Canada, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Ireland, Belgium, Sweden, and Japan.


The


[Indoor Camera 4K](https://www.amazon.com/RingIndoorCam4KWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) is available to purchase starting today in the U.S., Canada, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Ireland, Belgium, and Sweden.


The


[Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Camera 2K](https://www.amazon.com/RingPan-TiltIndoorCam2KWhite/ref=o_pr_ring_us_amznnews) is available to purchase starting today in the U.S., Canada, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Ireland, Belgium, Sweden, Australia, and New Zealand.


Customers can visit their local Amazon website for pricing and more details in their region.

[Ring Smart Lock](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/ring-smart-lock-battery-recharge) : a new keyless lock you can recharge by hand with a built-in power dial.
